title: acourtia nana
intro: Acourtia nana, commonly known as the dwarf fleabane or false chamomile, is a plant species in the daisy family that is native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing anxiety and promoting relaxation, thanks to its therapeutic actions as a mild sedative and anxiolytic. The bioactive constituents of Acourtia nana include flavonoids, terpenes, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including insomnia, restlessness, and digestive problems.
